# f5xc_rate_limiter_policy (Resource)

Rate Limiter Policy Rate limiter policy defines parameters that can be used for fine-grained control over requests for a http load balancer that are subjected to rate limiting. It will create the following child objects. * service_policy * service_policy_rule

To get more information about f5xc_rate_limiter_policy, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-rate-limiter-policy)
